title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Decision Table: Cost Share of Fills Settled at an Outside or Retail Pharmacy
content:
Some fills on a Specialty Pharmacy Program enrollment are dispensed by an outside specialty pharmacy or a retail pharmacy. Their cost share was settled at the pharmacy that dispensed them, and it is set aside from the enrollment's open balance as follows.

**Rule.**

- When no payment on the enrollment's ledger names the latest such fill of either kind, their whole cost share is set aside from the open balance, having been settled at the dispensing pharmacy.
- When payments on the ledger name the latest such fill of either kind, their cost share less those payments is set aside.
- When the enrollment has no fill dispensed outside Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy, nothing is set aside.

**Terms.**

- **Such fills** are the enrollment's shipped fills dispensed by an outside specialty pharmacy, together with those dispensed by a retail pharmacy.
- **Their cost share** is the total cost share of all such fills.
- **The latest such fill of either kind** means the latest fill dispensed by a retail pharmacy and the latest fill dispensed by an outside specialty pharmacy, each by ship date.
- **Those payments** are the payments on the ledger, from any payer, that name either of those latest fills.

## Decision table

| Fills dispensed outside Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy | Payments naming the latest such fill of either kind | Set aside |
|---|---|---|
| None | n/a | nothing |
| One or more | none | their whole cost share |
| One or more | some | their cost share less those payments |

## Worked cases (assumed figures)

| Outside-dispensed fills on the enrollment | Payments naming the latest such fill of either kind | Set aside |
|---|---|---|
| Retail fills of $50.00 (older) and $60.00 (latest) | none | $110.00 |
| Retail fills of $50.00 (older) and $60.00 (latest) | $20.00 on the $60.00 fill | $90.00 |
| One outside specialty pharmacy fill of $300.00 and one retail fill of $50.00 | $10.00 on the outside specialty pharmacy fill | $340.00 |
| Only Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy fills | n/a | $0.00 |
